verdict.rationale: BugSnag's integrations docs state that you can "create and sync issues in Jira, or your team's issue tracker," which is first-party evidence of linking errors to tickets with some form of sync. Nothing in the evidence documents the two-way status behavior: closing a ticket resolving the error, or a regression reopening it. GitHub Issues and Linear are not named. Missing for 10: explicit two-way status sync documentation, ticket-fix-resolves-error behavior, regression-reopens-ticket behavior, named GitHub Issues and Linear support, independent or hands-on corroboration.
